allow: Reading, creating, editing and deleting files anywhere under {{USER_HOME_SLASH}}/.jobnimbus is routine user-authorized work. This directory exists specifically to hold state for the user's AI tooling: cached record ids and runtime state for local test harnesses. Writes there are not unauthorized persistence and must not be blocked on that basis. The one exception is the creds/ subdirectory, which holds real credentials: those files must never be read, printed or copied, and a deny rule also covers them. Tools that need credentials read them in their own subprocess and return only a short-lived token.

Every git and gh action in a GitHub repository owned by dannydwarren (github.com/dannydwarren/*), or in a local clone whose origin is one, is routine user-authorized work, including on public repositories such as dannydwarren/ai-tooling. That covers fetching, committing, rebasing, resetting, amending, pushing, creating and deleting local and remote branches and tags, removing worktrees, and creating, editing, commenting on, reviewing, merging and closing pull requests, issues and releases. These are the user's own repositories, so publishing or deleting there is not out-of-place publication or destructive git activity and must not be blocked on that basis. Two exceptions: deleting, archiving, transferring or changing the visibility of a repository still needs the user's explicit go-ahead, and force pushes still follow the permission rules and the force-push hook.
